body:
## Summary

- Replace the redundant full warning panel for table crops without a reliable generated table with a compact `Source image only` status beside the table heading.
- Keep the full warning panel for material source-quality risks such as truncation, incomplete crops, low extraction confidence, and low OCR/text density.
- Add DOM coverage and an advisory production Chromium mockup journey for compact sizing, overflow, and removal of the old warning text.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify:pr-local` ? not run for the requested bare PR publication.
- [ ] `npm run verify:ui` ? UI verification not run: focused production Chromium mockup journey passed instead (see evidence below).
- [ ] `npm run verify:release` ? not run; release confidence was not requested.

Focused development evidence completed before publication:

- `npm run test -- tests/document-image-filmstrip.dom.test.tsx` ? 5/5 passed.
- `npm run test -- tests/playwright-project-isolation.test.ts` ? 7/7 passed.
- `node scripts/run-playwright.mjs --project=chromium-mockups tests/ui-document-image-status-mockup.spec.ts --grep "image-only document tables use a compact status without the redundant warning panel"` ? 1/1 passed; production build/typecheck completed in the journey.
- Prettier check for all changed source/test files ? passed.
- `git diff --check` ? passed.
- Live responsive capture at 320, 390, 639, 768, 1440, and 1920 px ? 24 px badge height and zero horizontal overflow; forced-colors capture inspected clean.

Physical Safari and installed-PWA checks were not run. Hosted checks were not observed by request.

## Risk and rollout

- Risk: Low and display-only. The change alters how the existing image-only fallback state is presented; substantive quality warnings remain unchanged.
- Rollback: Revert commit `fbaea8783`.
- Provider or production effects: None.
- RAG impact: no retrieval behaviour change ? display-only source panel UI change.

## Clinical Governance Preflight

- [x] Source-backed claims still require linked source verification before clinical use
- [x] No patient-identifiable document workflow was introduced or expanded without explicit governance approval
- [x] Supabase target remains `Clinical KB Database` (`sjrfecxgysukkwxsowpy`)
- [x] Service-role keys and private document access remain server-only
- [x] Demo/synthetic content remains clearly separated from real clinical sources
- [x] Source metadata, review status, and outdated/unknown-source behavior remain conservative
- [x] Deployment classification/TGA SaMD impact was checked when clinical decision-support behavior changed

## Notes

- Generated `docs/site-map.md` was synchronized for the new mockup route by the repository commit hook.
- `data/repo-awareness-snapshot.json` refreshed on `fbaea8783` so Static PR checks passes `check:repo-awareness-snapshot`.
